meta.name: product-marketing
meta.description: When the user wants to create or update their product marketing context document. Also use when the user mentions 'product context,' 'marketing context,' 'set up context,' 'positioning,' 'who is my target audience,' 'describe my product,' 'ICP,' 'ideal customer profile,' or wants to avoid repeating foundational information across marketing tasks. Use this at the start of any new project before using other marketing skills — it creates `.agents/product-marketing.md` that all other skills reference for product, audience, and positioning context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立产品营销背景档案，统一各营销任务的定位口径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写营销内容前都要反复交代产品背景
copy.tagline_en: Create a shared product marketing context doc for consistent messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of repeating product details in every marketing brief

howto.what: Claude 会帮你创建或更新一份产品营销背景文档，存在 .agents/product-marketing.md，记录产品定位、目标客户、竞争对手、客户原话等信息，供其他营销技能引用，避免每次重复说明。
howto.when: 当你说要设置产品/营销背景、提到 "positioning"、"ICP" 等关键词时触发；也会在开始新项目、使用其他营销技能之前触发，以便先建立一份产品背景文档，避免反复说明基础信息。

say.text: 把产品背景写成文档放到 .agents 里
say.note: 先查有没有旧文档，有就读旧版并列出要更新板块；没有则新建。

say.text: 更新一下营销背景，目标客户现在是中小企业
say.note: 只收集目标客户相关的问题，保存时版本号加一。

say.text: 从仓库代码自动起草营销背景文档

howto.what_en: Claude helps create or maintain a product marketing context doc at `.agents/product-marketing.md`, covering positioning, audience, competitors, customer language, goals, etc. Other marketing skills read it so you don't repeat basics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up product/marketing context, or mention "positioning," "ICP," etc. Also runs at the start of a new project, before other marketing skills, so you don't repeat foundational info.

say_en.text: Put my product marketing context into a doc in .agents.
say_en.note: Checks for an existing document first, then creates or updates.

say_en.text: Update my context — target audience is now SMBs.
say_en.note: Asks only about that section, then bumps the version.

say_en.text: Auto-draft the marketing context from the repo.
say_en.note: Reads README, landing pages, package.json, drafts V1 for review.
